# A table with a memo and an index, filled, encrypted, and its memo values changed and freed. On each dictionary of 00_create.txt.
connect Data Source=%D\c\c.add;ServerType=LOCAL;User ID=ADSSYS;EncryptionType=AES128;FIPS=FALSE;DDPassword=ddpw;
sql EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyDatabase('ENCRYPT_NEW_TABLE', 'FALSE')
sql CREATE TABLE tm (id INTEGER, note MEMO, name CHAR(20))
sql CREATE INDEX tm_name ON tm (name)
sql INSERT INTO tm VALUES (1, 'xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx', 'alpha')
sql INSERT INTO tm VALUES (2, '', 'beta')
sql INSERT INTO tm VALUES (3, '', 'gamma')
sql EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_EncryptTable('tm')
sql INSERT INTO tm VALUES (4, 'xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx', 'delta')
sql UPDATE tm SET note = '' WHERE id = 1
sql UPDATE tm SET note = 'xxxxxxxxxx' WHERE id = 3
sql DELETE FROM tm WHERE id = 2
sql INSERT INTO tm VALUES (5, '', 'epsilon')
disconnect
